metadata.description: Umbrella marketplace for the Fused Gaming / SyncPulse skill ecosystem. Packages are being split out of Fused-Gaming-Skill-MCP into individual single-purpose repositories; each entry below tracks a package's current location and will be repointed to its own repo as extraction completes. Only entries with a real, non-scaffold implementation are listed.
